{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data structure
print('Shape:', trial_df.shape)
print('\n')

# Check for missing values
print('Missing values per column:')
print(trial_df.isnull().sum())
print('\n')

# Check unique values in key columns
print('Unique values in `arm`:')
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())
print('\n')

print('Unique values in `severity`:')
print(trial_df['severity'].value_counts())
print('\n')

print('Unique values in `sex`:')
print(trial_df['sex'].value_counts())
print('\n')

print('Unique values in `assay_batch`:')
print(trial_df['assay_batch'].value_counts())
print('\n')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker columns
print('Biomarker baseline - sentinel values:')
print(trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].value_counts().head())
print('\n')

print('Biomarker final - sentinel values:')
print(trial_df['biomarker_final'].value_counts().head())"}
